title: 💳 Oppo May Charge a Subscription for AI Features… Credit You Top Up for Every Use!
body: 💳 Oppo May Charge a Subscription for AI Features… Credit You Top Up for Every Use!
New reports suggest that Oppo is considering charging for extra use of AI features, after launching a wide package of these features with the ColorOS 17 update.

According to the reports, the company plans to launch AI plans that add credit to the user's account, and this credit is consumed with each extra use of the smart features after the free limit is exceeded.
The idea is not entirely new in the tech world, as AI is expensive to run, and many companies have started looking for a way to cover its cost instead of offering it for free forever.
But the decision could change the user experience completely: a feature you got used to for free could turn into a paid service, and you would have to choose which features are worth paying for.
Oppo has not officially announced the plans or prices yet, nor which features will stay free and which will fall under the subscription, but the reports suggest the direction is now clear.
Simply put: the free AI on your phone may become a subscription; would you pay for smart features you got used to for free?
Which AI features on your phone are worth paying for?
